ranked.headline: Latent-variable models separate confounded sources in single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Recent work applies disentangled and causal generative models to separate biological variation from confounders in single-cell and spatial omics.

ranked.headline: Software for profiling microbial composition and function from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications quantify limits of metagenomic profiling and test consensus strategies across differential abundance methods.

ranked.headline: Generative models now design and benchmark target-directed small molecules
ranked.summary: MolGenBench now evaluates structure-based generators across 120 protein targets and 220,005 confirmed actives.

ranked.headline: Pseudotime and cell-cycle positions anchor single-cell trajectory analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints use pseudotime and cell-cycle position as explicit structure in scRNA-seq analyses, for trajectory differential expression and network…

ranked.headline: Long-read methods resolve structural, haplotype and mitochondrial variation in human…
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now supports local assembly, phasing and allele reconstruction for complex human variation across individual genomes and populations.

ranked.headline: Multimodal spatial profiling resolves cell states across human development and health
ranked.summary: Integrated spatial and single-cell resources now place molecular states within tissue geometry and developmental time.

ranked.headline: Inferring gene regulation from sequence, splicing, and chromatin across tissues
ranked.summary: Long-read, reporter, and cell-free DNA readouts now resolve regulatory activity more finely across tissues and cell types.

ranked.headline: Learned molecular graphs and sequences couple generation with property constraints
ranked.summary: Pretrained transformers and graph models now target property-conditioned generation and prediction with explicit constraints.

ranked.headline: Diffusion models generate biomolecular conformations, ligand poses and antibody CDRs
ranked.summary: Learned geometric generators now target conformational ensembles and complexes, with benchmarks testing whether models recover folding landscapes.

ranked.headline: LLMs and transformer agents applied to rare disease, glioma, and omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test LLMs for interpretable, zero-shot, and agent-based inference across diagnosis, gene prioritization, and omics annotation.

ranked.headline: Label-efficient segmentation methods for microscopy and whole-slide pathology imaging
ranked.summary: Self-supervised, self-training and fine-tuning strategies are being applied to segmentation across histopathology, electron and multiplexed microscopy.

ranked.headline: Dynamical structure, not tuned parameters, underlies robustness in biological networks
ranked.summary: Recent models of cell cycle, gene regulatory, and epithelial networks locate robustness in bifurcation proximity, canalization, and feedback structure.

ranked.headline: Nucleotide foundation models benchmarked and extended for DNA and RNA function
ranked.summary: Large benchmarks and multimodal pretraining now test nucleotide foundation models on DNA and RNA fitness, structure and regulation.

ranked.headline: ML models predict antimicrobial activity and resistance from sequence and structure
ranked.summary: Antimicrobial peptides are promising against resistance, and new models now pair prediction with experimental testing of designed compounds.

ranked.headline: Graph and attention models integrate heterogeneous evidence for biological prediction
ranked.summary: Graph encoders, language-model embeddings, and cross-attention are now fused across multimodal data for drug-target and protein function prediction.

ranked.headline: Interactive tools for RNA structure, pangenome, amplicon, and probe design analysis
ranked.summary: Specialized sequence, structure, and omics analyses are increasingly delivered as interactive, reproducible tools with exportable output.

ranked.headline: Supervised models predict cancer subtype and mutations from histology and omics data
ranked.summary: Histopathology-based and low-data predictors now report AUCs of 0.87 to 0.99, alongside new open-source Python tools for omics and cancer progression analysis.

ranked.headline: Learned models replace explicit stages in genomic and viral sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Learned sequence and signal models now operate directly on raw reads, traces, and nucleotides, reducing hand-engineered intermediate stages.

ranked.headline: Data-class-specific tools recover viral genomes and denoise metabarcoding reads
ranked.summary: Tools for virus taxonomy, metagenome recovery, and metabarcoding denoising are now packaged for specific data classes, as in vConTACT3, BEREN, and HAPP.

ranked.headline: Physics and geometry constraints refine biomolecular structure and dynamics models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair physical priors and geometric constraints with ML to predict kinase conformations, allostery, protein properties and DNA dynamics.

ranked.headline: Computational tools link sequence variation to folding energy and protein design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints release tools for variant effect prediction, bacterial population variation profiling, and protein selection analysis.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and correlation-based networks tested for omics dependency recovery
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and bootstrap tests now probe whether learned network structures recover true edges and differ reliably between fits.

ranked.headline: Consumer-resource models tie resource supply to colonization resistance and persistence
ranked.summary: Dengue infects nearly 390 million people annually, and new mechanistic models of resource, vector, and pathogen dynamics test persistence and resistance.

ranked.headline: Automating preparation of predicted structures for molecular dynamics simulation
ranked.summary: Recent tools convert cofolding, conformer, and AlphaFold outputs into MD-ready inputs, while mdBIRCH adds memory-bounded online trajectory clustering.

ranked.headline: Linking neuronal metabolism, brain anatomy, and genetics across biological scales
ranked.summary: Subtype-resolved metabolic models, AI-derived callosal morphometry, and multi-site imaging tools now probe brain organization across scales.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic rules shape collective dynamics in condensates, tissue, and neurons
ranked.summary: Local feedback rules, random crosslinks, and connectivity anisotropies each set network-scale behavior in recent computational models.

ranked.headline: Optimized non-equispaced sampling improves rhythm detection in biological time series
ranked.summary: Preprints on menopause-anchored lab trajectories and ovarian aging, plus a November 2025 sampling-design study, sharpen focus on temporal sampling.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic network models rank cancer targets, drug combinations and intervention sets
ranked.summary: Spatial, Boolean and interactome-based models now generate testable predictions for immunotherapy response, target pairs, and drug synergy.

ranked.headline: Simulation paired with learned analysis resolves protein conformational mechanisms
ranked.summary: Recent studies pair MD with learned analysis or Markov state models to map asymmetric, ATP-driven, and lipid-triggered conformational transitions.

ranked.headline: Automated mining of literature and public omics data into biological networks
ranked.summary: Public abstracts, transcriptomic repositories, and multiomics databases are now being converted into queryable network models by automated tools.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve histone tail, CENP-N, and DSIF effects on nucleic acid dynamics
ranked.summary: Simulations now couple regulator binding and chromatin elements to nucleic acid conformational dynamics and allosteric routing.

ranked.headline: Consistent species tree methods under incomplete sorting and genome-scale confidence
ranked.summary: Consistent gene and network species tree methods now sit alongside confidence assessment applied to a two-million-genome SARS-CoV-2 tree.

ranked.headline: Transport-based metrics quantify shape heterogeneity in skulls and protein structures
ranked.summary: Metric geometry and stratified kernels offer fast, interpretable comparisons of shape across avian skulls, protein structures and point-cloud populations.

ranked.headline: Open tools converting lipidomics, metabolomics and MRS data into interpretable outputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package lipidomics, GNPS metabolomics and MRS analyses as open, accessible tools for interpretation.

ranked.headline: Inferring biological dynamics and interaction parameters directly from data
ranked.summary: Data-driven inference is now coupled to multi-scale structure, Bayesian ODE formulations, and compositional observations in biological models.

ranked.headline: Models link vaccine immunity build-up and waning to reinfection and dosing timing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model waning protection and reinfection with explicit immunity age structure to inform vaccination timing.
